summary: Lincoln National Corporation filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, reporting the completion of an offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 6.800% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Subordinated Notes due 2056. The company sold these notes to underwriters including Wells Fargo, BofA, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and TD Securities under an underwriting agreement dated June 24, 2026. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a public debt offering by the issuer—not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, spin-off, or other special event triggering a separate category.
